introduction: This is Angel Godd-Santana's AI assistant, operated through Godd Technologies, LLC's CallDesk workflow for ordinary professional inquiries. You are interacting with software, not Angel.

modes.text: In text mode, your typed messages and the assistant's replies are stored as a transcript so Angel can reply to your inquiry. Conversation and model providers process those messages. Text mode does not request microphone access.
modes.voice: In voice mode, your spoken conversation is recorded and transcribed so Angel can reply to your inquiry. The assistant uses an AI-generated version of Angel Godd-Santana's voice. Conversation, model and speech providers process the interaction. Choose voice and expressly agree to this notice before any microphone request.

retention: The adopted policy is effective October 7, 2026. Default disposition eligibility is the verified actual conversation start plus 90 elapsed days of 24 hours each in UTC. An explicit Owner Keep decision must identify the records, reason and review date. A business relationship does not create Keep automatically, and releasing Keep does not restart the original clock.
copies: Disposition requires verified records and copies and separately approved execution. Notion Trash is recoverable. Azure disposition-control metadata and email, push, downloads, logs and backups require separate handling. The policy does not promise permanent erasure of every copy on day 90.
providers: The workflow uses ElevenLabs for conversation and speech processing, Microsoft Azure for Company hosting and storage, and Notion for the Company inbox. Language-model generation uses OpenAI Luna with Google Gemini fallback; analysis and any additional fallback processing must be included in the verified release disclosure. Email and push notifications can create separate copies. The assistant stays unavailable until the actual provider roles, applicable data-use terms and retention controls are verified.
restrictions: Do not submit credentials, full payment-card details, classified information, CUI, nonpublic FCI, export-controlled data or other restricted or sensitive information. AI replies require human review and cannot book a meeting, confirm employment availability, quote rates or create an engagement.
alternative: If you prefer not to use the assistant, email support@goddtechnologies.com. Privacy requests use the same address with the subject Privacy Request. Angel's existing professional contact links remain separate.
